security_audit.summary: Most static findings are Markdown backtick fences or safe relative artifact writes in SKILL.md, so they are adjudicated as false positives. One semantic issue remains: the generated inference script loads serialized ML artifacts without a trust-boundary warning, which can be unsafe with untrusted files.

remediation.issue: Deployment inference loads serialized ML artifacts without a trust-boundary warning.
remediation.suggestion: State that model_path and scaler_path must point to trusted local artifacts, and prefer safer formats when accepting user uploads.

semantic_findings.title: Unsafe Serialized Model Artifact Loading
semantic_findings.description: The generated inference script loads model and scaler files from caller-provided paths using TensorFlow and joblib. Untrusted serialized artifacts can execute code or load unsafe objects, so the skill should add a trust-boundary warning.
semantic_findings.confidence_reasoning: The code directly calls load_model(model_path) and joblib.load(scaler_path). The intended artifacts are local, but the parameters are paths and no trusted-source warning is present.

content.user_title: Build ML Models With Expert Workflow
content.value_statement: ML model projects need a repeatable path from data preparation to deployment. This skill gives Claude, Codex, and Claude Code a structured workflow for training, evaluation, and packaging.
actual_capabilities: Guides data loading, cleaning, splitting, and normalization for supervised learning tasks.
Shows model selection logic for classification, regression, clustering, dense networks, and convolutional networks.
Defines TensorFlow training configuration with callbacks, metrics, batch size, and epoch settings.
Documents evaluation steps with test metrics, classification reports, and training history summaries.
Packages model artifacts, preprocessing files, reports, and an inference script for deployment.
limitations: Examples assume a local dataset named dataset.csv and a target column.
It does not provide data privacy controls or dataset governance guidance.
TensorFlow and scikit-learn examples need adaptation for other frameworks.
Deployment steps are sample packaging instructions, not production infrastructure automation.

use_cases.title: Prototype a Classifier
use_cases.description: Build a first supervised learning model with clean data splits, normalized features, and baseline validation metrics.

use_cases.title: Prepare Deployment Artifacts
use_cases.description: Export trained models, save preprocessing assets, and assemble a deployment folder with an inference entry point.

use_cases.title: Compare Model Architectures
use_cases.description: Evaluate task complexity, feature count, and data size before selecting a neural network or classical model approach.

prompt_templates.title: Start a Basic Model
prompt_templates.scenario: Beginner setup for a new dataset
prompt_templates.prompt: Use this skill to build a basic classification model from my dataset. Ask for the target column, metric goal, and deployment format first.

prompt_templates.title: Prepare Training Data
prompt_templates.prompt: Use this skill to clean my tabular data, split train validation test sets, select a model architecture, and define training callbacks.

prompt_templates.title: Package for Deployment
prompt_templates.prompt: Use this skill to design a production ML workflow with evaluation reports, model artifact packaging, and inference script generation.

prompt_templates.title: Audit an ML Pipeline
prompt_templates.prompt: Use this skill to review my ML pipeline for overfitting, leakage, metric choice, artifact safety, and deployment readiness.

output_examples.input: Train a classification model for customer churn prediction.
output: Data audit summary with missing values, feature types, and target balance.
Recommended dense neural network with training callbacks and validation metrics.
Deployment checklist covering model file, scaler file, report, and inference entry point.

output_examples.input: Evaluate whether my trained model is ready for release.
output: Test metric summary with overfitting indicators and validation gaps.
Evaluation report outline with classification details and training history.
Release readiness notes for artifact safety, reproducibility, and documentation.

output_examples.input: Create a mobile-friendly export plan for a TensorFlow model.
output: TensorFlow Lite export plan with required preprocessing artifacts.
Deployment package inventory for local inference and mobile integration.
Operational limits for latency, model size, and trusted artifact handling.

best_practices: Define the target metric and acceptance threshold before training begins.
Keep train, validation, and test data separated throughout preprocessing and evaluation.
Record model parameters, training history, data assumptions, and artifact versions.
anti_patterns: Do not evaluate only on training data or tune repeatedly on the test set.
Do not package model artifacts without documenting preprocessing requirements.
Do not load serialized artifacts from untrusted sources during inference.

faq.question: What type of ML work does this skill support?
faq.answer: It supports structured model development, including data preparation, model selection, training, evaluation, and deployment packaging.

faq.question: Can it choose between TensorFlow and PyTorch?
faq.answer: The examples focus on TensorFlow. PyTorch users can adapt the phases and validation checks to their own framework.

faq.question: Does it train a model automatically?
faq.answer: It provides workflow guidance and example steps. Actual training depends on the connected tools, data, and runtime environment.

faq.question: Can it help with production deployment?
faq.answer: It prepares model artifacts, reports, and an inference script. It does not configure cloud infrastructure or monitoring systems.

faq.question: What inputs should I provide?
faq.answer: Provide the dataset location, target column, task type, success metric, framework preference, and deployment target.

faq.question: Is it safe for sensitive datasets?
faq.answer: Use local privacy controls before running examples. The skill does not include compliance, anonymization, or access control guidance.
